keys.description: Name of the court that issued this decision, exactly as written in the document.
The date on which this decision was issued (the date of the judgment, usually in the signature line at the end).

The kind of court document. judgment = a final decision on the merits (ítélet); partial_judgment = a decision on part of the claims (részítélet); interim_judgment = a preliminary decision on a point of principle (közbenső ítélet); order = a procedural or non-merits decision (végzés); other = anything else.
